div.div: 5 تبسّر : see 1, in four places. It signifies also (assumed tropical:) He sought for, or after, fresh water recently produced by rain. (S. [See بُسْرٌ.]) And (assumed tropical:) He dug for plants before they came forth: (M, TA:) [or] تبسّر نَبَاتًا has this meaning. (TA.) And (assumed tropical:) He (a [wild] bull) came to the roots of dry plants, and ate them. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
